criteria.name: Requested compact JSON
criteria.description: Provides the target family, rainfall windows, NYC feedback values, and final label in the requested compact object.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if the structure is mostly correct but one required group is missing or field names are unclear.

criteria.name: Event total and peak hour
criteria.description: Computes 133.9 mm total precipitation, 33.8 mm peak hour at 2021-09-02T01:00 UTC, and 0.2524 peak-hour fraction.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct values with minor rounding or time-format errors; 1 point for only the total or peak value.

criteria.name: Rolling rainfall windows
criteria.description: Computes the 79.8 mm maximum 3-hour window with 0.596 fraction and the 98.3 mm maximum 6-hour window with 0.7341 fraction.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for one correct rolling window or small rounding errors; 1 point for using rolling-window logic but choosing the wrong maximum.

criteria.name: NYC feedback shares
criteria.description: Computes 500 records, 0.914 sewer share, 0.892 street-flooding share, 0.998 September 1-2 share, and 0.244 top-hour share.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct counts but missing, swapped, or misrounded shares; award 1 point for only identifying the complaint-record source.

criteria.name: Consistency interpretation
criteria.description: Uses the rainfall fractions and feedback shares to conclude concentrated multi-hour rainfall with NYC drainage feedback.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points if the conclusion is broadly right but does not use both the rainfall concentration and local-feedback values; award 1 point for the right label without calculation-backed interpretation.

criteria.name: Concise bounded answer
criteria.description: Avoids management guidance and broad narrative beyond the computed consistency result.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for minor extra prose that does not alter the numerical conclusion.
